_comment: Sample payload template for wiring this app into a Make.com (Integromat) scenario on the free plan. Use an HTTP module 'Make a request' pointed at your deployed server, or a Custom Webhook trigger that receives this shape from AUTOMATION_WEBHOOK_URL after a booking is confirmed.

incoming_call_trigger.description: Webhook trigger module: 'Custom webhook' listening for a new call/message and forwarding audio or text to this app's /api/voice/incoming endpoint.

body_fields.audio: (binary audio file from the call recording, e.g. WEBM/OPUS or WAV/LINEAR16)
body_fields.sessionId: {{optional - reuse to keep conversation context across turns}}
body_fields.callerPhone: {{caller's phone number from the telephony provider}}

expected_response.audioBase64: base64-encoded MP3 audio to play back to the caller

check_availability_module.description: HTTP module to check open slots before offering times to a caller/lead via a chatbot flow.

book_appointment_module.description: HTTP module to finalize a booking once the caller confirms a slot.

automation_webhook_receiver.description: If AUTOMATION_WEBHOOK_URL is set in .env, this app POSTs here automatically right after every successful booking so Make.com can send SMS/email confirmations, update a CRM, or notify a technician.
